summary: Phase 2 backend regression: 17/17 pytest cases PASS against public URL https://ciber-educativo.preview.emergentagent.com. Verified health, DEMO-001 school seeding, invalid session -> 401, auth/me returns full user (school_code=DEMO-001, role=student, grade=6°, group=A), /lessons/complete (passwords, 3/3) grants +30 XP and unlocks 'guardian' badge, /games/complete (fraude, 5/6) grants +30 XP, +10 coins and unlocks 'detective', /daily/claim first call = +20 XP +15 coins and second call = 400, /leaderboards/weekly (school and global) returns rows sorted by XP desc with rank starting at 1 and week_start on Monday 00:00 UTC plus 'me' object, /certificates/passwords returns a valid non-empty PDF (magic %PDF), /certificates/phishing returns 400 for uncompleted module, /teacher/roster returns 403 for student token and 200 with groups list for teacher token, /schools/join returns 404 for invalid code and promotes role for DEMO-001, /chatbot returns a Spanish reply from Claude Sonnet 4.6 that does NOT ask for personal data. Google auth UI not exercised (real Google flow, per request).
action_items: None blocking. Optional hardening: _seen_session_ids is an in-memory set — after a backend restart, a real Emergent session_id could be replayed. Consider persisting used session_ids in Mongo with a TTL. Low priority since the Emergent session_id itself is short-lived.
Optional: /chatbot depends on live Claude; add graceful timeout messaging on the client if the 502 branch triggers.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 761-line file. Still readable, but consider splitting into routers/ (auth, schools, progress, leaderboards, certificates, chatbot, teacher) once Phase 3 begins.

Weekly leaderboard: relies on TTL-free weekly_scores collection scoped by week_start. Auto-reset is implicit (new Monday -> new documents). Old weeks accumulate; a cron/TTL for stale weeks would be nice but not required.
current_user helper is invoked correctly with await; all Mongo ops properly async; _id is projected out everywhere. Good.
Certificates endpoint accepts token via `?t=` query param — makes browser links possible; acceptable but note it is logged in server access logs. Fine for MVP.
